verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state sessions expose a WebSocket endpoint compatible with Playwright, Puppeteer, or any CDP-compatible tool, and the intro reiterates 'Control Chrome browsers in the cloud using Puppeteer, Playwright, or our SDKs.' This directly supports connecting existing automation code without rewriting it, plus profiles for persisting cookies/session state across sessions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of drop-in compatibility with existing large codebases and any noted friction points.
